title: Electrical Work Permit (Enhanced)
description: Free Electrical Work Permit (Enhanced) template for oil & gas you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers permit information, work team, electrical hazard identification & risk assessment.

Check all hazards applicable to this electrical work:

PRIMARY ELECTRICAL HAZARDS:
☐ Electric shock / electrocution

☐ Electrical fire
☐ Explosion (due to electrical fault)

☐ Testing / troubleshooting with power on

☐ Working on underground cables
☐ Working in confined space (electrical)
☐ Working at height (electrical)
☐ Working in wet/damp conditions		EQUIPMENT-RELATED HAZARDS:
☐ Damaged insulation / cables
☐ Exposed conductors
